title: Bank Account
description:
```
Opened account #1001 for Ada
Deposit $50.00 ... ok
Withdraw $80.00 ... refused (balance $50.00)
Statement for #1001 (Ada)
  + $50.00   deposit
  balance $50.00
```
hints: `withdraw` checks before it changes anything: if the amount is more than the balance, return `false` and leave the account as it was. That is how a class keeps its invariant (lesson 6.09).
`static inline int s_nextNumber` belongs to the class, not to one account, so every new account takes the next number from it (lesson 6.05).
requirements: `class BankAccount` with private balance (in cents), owner, account number
Static counter generating unique account numbers
A transaction history `std::vector<Transaction>` (nested struct) and `printStatement() const`
Invariant: balance never negative — `assert` it after each operation
